Brand new and spacious 2 bedroom apartment with 2 bathrooms located in Central Reykjavík. A stone's throw away from the sea and everything central Reykjavik has to offer is within walking distance from the apartment. 

The apartment comfortably sleeps 6 people. It’s an ideal location for enjoying the charm of Reykjavik.

24H Check In with a Keycode.

The space
The apartment comfortably sleeps 6 adults

The Master bedroom features a super comfortable large double bed a large en-suite bathroom and plenty of closet space.

The second bedroom features a super comfortable large double bed.

The living area features a very comfortable and easily convertible pullout sleeping couch. that is suitable for 2 adults.

There is a large open plan kitchen which is fully equipped with a fridge, stove, microwave, toaster, coffee maker and an assortment of pots and pans. Guests will find everything they need to prepare a nice meal. 

There are 2 balconies

The living area has a large flat screen TV with 200+ cable channels. (if you want to spend the evening in front of the TV :)

Video controlled doorbell

Free Hi Speed WiFi throughout the propertie.

Guest access
Guests have access to the entire apartment with complete privacy.

Other things to note
There is Dorbell camera outside
